params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; Write-Output '=== BRIDGE_PROCESSES ==='; Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -and ($_.CommandLine -like '*HeavenBridge*' -or $_.CommandLine -like '*heaven-desktop-worker.py*') } | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CreationDate,CommandLine | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4; Write-Output '=== STARTUP ==='; $startup=[Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup'); Get-ChildItem -Force $startup | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'Heaven|Bridge' } | Select-Object FullName,Name,Length,LastWriteTime | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3; Write-Output '=== SCHEDULED_TASKS ==='; Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskName -match 'Heaven|Bridge' } | Select-Object TaskName,TaskPath,State | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3

purpose: Audit obsolete v1 agent-bridge worker/startup artifacts before safe consolidation; read-only.
